title: Flawed
text: Flawed. This is a plastic frame with mat. The frame itself is decent. It's light weight and looks good. It has hangers on the backside so you can hang it vertically or horizontally. One of the sets was flawed with a strange line through the glass. My husband thought at first that it was a piece of protective plastic film, but upon closer inspection, it was a flaw in the actual glass. It's not a crack. It's really odd and something we've never seen before. The other one was fine. I've included a picture. It's hard to see because of the reflection, but the line is in the middle from the top of the glass.
